nodes.label: App Shell Sidebar (52px Icon Rail)
nodes.rationale: Fixed 52px icon-only rail (bg #E7E7EA) reused identically by both screens: logo, section nav, a flex spacer, settings, then divider and account avatar pinned to the bottom.

nodes.label: Archived Project Actions (Restaurar / Delete)
nodes.rationale: Archived cards trade the 'Abrir proyecto' affordance for 'Restaurar' plus a destructive trash button, i.e. archived projects expose recovery instead of entry — the action set encodes the item's lifecycle state.

nodes.label: Collaborator Avatar Stack (AL, MG)
nodes.rationale: Overlapping initials circles (AL, MG) sit in the meta row of the grid card only, signalling shared ownership/team members without adding a separate member list.

nodes.label: Continuar trabajando Section (Continue Working Rail)
nodes.rationale: Recency-oriented rail: a section header ('Continuar trabajando' + 'Ver todos' text link in accent blue) over a fixed 130px row of three equal-width project cards, capped at three so the rail stays scannable rather than becoming a second list.

nodes.label: 12 · Home — Inicio HTML Design Export
nodes.rationale: Self-contained static HTML export of two 1728x1080 app screens (Home and Proyectos) rendered side by side at 3616px width, using Tailwind CDN plus absolute-positioned flex trees and per-node data-pencil-name attributes so the export round-trips back into the design tool.

nodes.label: Generar nuevo plan Button
nodes.rationale: Secondary outlined action in the plan header that lets the user discard and re-request the generated daily plan, keeping the AI output revisable instead of authoritative.

nodes.label: Top Header Bar
nodes.rationale: 48px band (bg #EDEDF0) that holds a section-context chip on the left and a global search field on the right, separated by a flex spacer — the only chrome shared by every screen.

nodes.label: Nuevo proyecto Primary Button
nodes.rationale: The single accent-coloured (#007AFF) button in both screens' page headers, with a plus glyph and identical label/padding — one creation entry point repeated verbatim so 'start something new' is never more than a glance away.

nodes.label: Plan para hoy Section (Today Plan)
nodes.rationale: Tinted (#FAF8FE) header distinguishes the machine-suggested plan from user-authored content: sparkles glyph + 'Plan para hoy' + 'Sugerido por modus' chip + summary meta ('2 pendientes · ~1 h 30 min') + '1 completada' chip + a 'Generar nuevo plan' action, over a body of task rows. Progress is framed as a short, replenishable daily plan rather than an open backlog.

nodes.label: Project Progress Bar (Track, Fill, Percent)
nodes.rationale: Track + fill + right-aligned percent label; fill width encodes completion (35%, 68%, 22%, 48%, 100%, 12% across the sample projects) so cards are comparable at a glance without opening them.

nodes.label: Project Card
nodes.rationale: Core repeated object of the product: coloured icon tile + project name + overflow 'more' affordance, a one-line description, a progress row, and a meta/status row — the same anatomy is reused in the Home rail and in the Projects grid, with the grid variant adding collaborator avatars and hover actions.

nodes.label: Card Hover Actions (Abrir proyecto)
nodes.rationale: A hidden-by-default 'Hover Actions' layer with an 'Abrir proyecto' button appears on the first grid card, keeping the resting card clean while giving the primary navigation affordance only when the pointer is committed to that card.

nodes.label: Card Meta Row (tareas · en progreso · última actividad)
nodes.norm_label: card meta row (tareas · en progreso · ultima actividad)
nodes.rationale: Dense single line in the Home card combining 'n / m tareas', a coloured status dot with 'n en progreso', and a relative timestamp right-aligned by a flex spacer (e.g. 'hace 12 min', 'ayer', 'hace 3 días').

nodes.label: Card Status Row (estado + actualizado)
nodes.rationale: Projects-grid variant of the meta line: it splits the Home card's single row into a status block on the left (dot + 'n en progreso' / completed / archived) and an explicit 'Actualizado <relative time>' on the right.

nodes.label: Project Chip (Dot + Project Name)
nodes.rationale: Tiny neutral chip (coloured dot + project name) attached to each plan task, carrying project identity into the cross-project daily view without leaving the Home screen.

nodes.label: Project Filter Tabs (Todos / Activos / Completados / Archivados)
nodes.norm_label: project filter tabs (todos / activos / completados / archivados)
nodes.rationale: Segmented pill control on a #F0F0F2 trough with 2px padding, defaulting to 'Todos'; lifecycle states are the primary axis of the catalog, matching the three card variants shown below (active, completed, archived).

nodes.label: Project Search Field (Buscar proyectos…)
nodes.rationale: Second, wider search input living in the toolbar and scoped to the catalog ('Buscar proyectos…'), while the header keeps the unscoped 'Buscar en modus…' field — scope is conveyed purely by placeholder copy.

nodes.label: Project Sort Control (Ordenar por: Última actividad)
nodes.norm_label: project sort control (ordenar por: ultima actividad)
nodes.rationale: Outlined dropdown-style control that shows the active criterion as a value next to a chevron, defaulting to 'Última actividad' — recency first, consistent with the Home rail's ordering.

nodes.label: Project State Chips (Completado / Archivado)
nodes.rationale: Chips placed beside the project name in the card's top row ('Completado' for Sistema de Becas at 100%, 'Archivado' for App de Recetas) — terminal states are labelled at the title level rather than in the meta line.

nodes.label: Projects Grid (3-Column Rows with Spacers)
nodes.rationale: Card catalog built as flex rows of three cards with trailing 'Grid Spacer' divs keeping the empty slots of the last row, so partially filled rows preserve the column rhythm instead of stretching the remaining cards.

nodes.label: Projects Header (Title + Subtitle + CTA)
nodes.rationale: 20px bold title 'Proyectos' plus the grey invite 'Organiza todo lo que estás construyendo.' with the shared accent CTA on the right — the same title/subtitle/action header idiom as the Home screen's greeting block.

nodes.label: Global Search Field (Buscar en modus…)
nodes.rationale: 190px outlined field in the header with a magnifier glyph and the placeholder 'Buscar en modus…' — names the product as modus and scopes search globally rather than per screen.

nodes.label: Section Context Chip
nodes.rationale: White pill with a tinted accent icon plus the section name ('Inicio' on the home frame, 'Proyectos' on the projects frame); it re-states the active sidebar destination next to the search field so the current context survives a collapsed icon rail.

nodes.label: Sidebar Navigation Items (Inicio / Proyectos / Tareas / Configuración)
nodes.norm_label: sidebar navigation items (inicio / proyectos / tareas / configuracion)
nodes.rationale: 36x36 rounded-square nav targets; the active item is the only one filled with accent #007AFF while inactive icons are stroked in #6E6E73 — selection is signalled by fill, not by extra chrome.

nodes.label: Task State Chips (Completada / ~30 min / ~1 h)
nodes.rationale: Colour-coded micro-chips close each task row: green 'Completada' for finished work, neutral grey duration chips for estimated remaining effort — completion and effort use separate visual channels so the plan's remaining load stays readable.

nodes.label: Today Task Row
nodes.rationale: Three sibling rows with identical skeleton — checkbox (checked/unchecked), task text, project chip, then either a 'Completada' chip, a duration chip (~30 min, ~1 h) or nothing — so the list reads consistently whether a task is done, scheduled or open.

nodes.label: App de Recetas (demo project)
nodes.rationale: 'Recetario permodusl con modo cocina paso a paso', 12% (3/24 tareas, 'Archivado hace 1 mes') — the archived-state card example, deliberately shown at low progress to justify why it was set aside, and the only card exposing Restaurar/delete.

nodes.label: Geist Typeface
nodes.rationale: Every text node declares the same stack Geist, system-ui, sans-serif, loaded as a variable font (weights 100-900) from Google Fonts; weight and size, not family changes, carry the hierarchy (20px bold titles, 13px semibold section names, 10-12.5px metadata).

nodes.label: 12 · Home — Inicio (Home Screen)
nodes.rationale: Dashboard landing screen: greeting + primary CTA, a 'Continuar trabajando' rail of recent project cards, and an AI-suggested 'Plan para hoy' task list — answers 'what do I do today' rather than 'what exists'.

nodes.label: Lista de Compras (demo project)
nodes.rationale: 'Aplicación móvil para crear listas de compras', 22% (5/23 tareas, 1 en progreso, hace 3 días) — the early-stage active example, and the owner of the plan task 'Implementar búsqueda de productos' (~1 h).

nodes.label: Lucide Icon Set
nodes.rationale: Icons are inlined as SVG paths carrying data-icon-name / data-icon-set="lucide" (sparkles, house, folder, list-checks, settings, search, plus) at 13-17px in either grey #6E6E73, accent blue #007AFF or violet #AF52DE — colour, not icon choice, carries state.

nodes.label: Observatorio Regional (demo project)
nodes.rationale: Sample project 'Plataforma regional para gestión de investigación científica' at 35% (14/40 tareas, 3 en progreso, hace 12 min) — the recurring hero example used to demonstrate the active/in-progress card state on both screens, including the avatar stack AL/MG and hover action.

nodes.label: Portfolio permodusl (demo project)
nodes.rationale: 'Sitio permodusl y presentación de proyectos', 68% (17/25 tareas, 2 en progreso, ayer) — the late-stage active example, and the owner of the plan task 'Revisar responsive móvil' (~30 min).

nodes.label: 13 · Proyectos — Vista general (Projects Overview Screen)
nodes.rationale: Full project catalog screen: title + subtitle + 'Nuevo proyecto' CTA, a filter/sort/search toolbar, and a 3-column card grid covering all lifecycle states (active, completed, archived) — the management counterpart to the Home screen's curated view.

nodes.label: Red de Laboratorios (demo project)
nodes.rationale: 'Gestión compartida de equipos y muestras de laboratorio', 48% (12/25 tareas, 2 en progreso, hace 5 h) — appears only in the Proyectos grid, showing the grid surfaces work the Home rail omits.

nodes.label: Sistema de Becas (demo project)
nodes.rationale: 'Administración de convocatorias y postulaciones', 100% (31/31 tareas, 'Completado hace 2 semanas') — the completed-state card example backing the 'Completados' filter tab.

nodes.label: modus (AI Planning Assistant)
nodes.rationale: The assistant is surfaced as a violet sparkles glyph (#AF52DE) plus a 'Sugerido por modus' chip and a regenerate action, and the app's global search placeholder ('Buscar en modus…') uses the same name — suggestions are attributed to a named agent rather than presented as neutral app behaviour.

nodes.label: Ambient Glow Background Gradients
nodes.rationale: Design pattern: four 640px radial-gradient ellipses (blue #4D9BFF, violet #B37DF0, orange #FFB86B, cyan #5AC8FA, each at ~24% alpha) layered absolutely behind the content at staggered offsets and z-index 0-3, giving the flat #F2F2F4 canvas depth and colour identity without imagery; deliberately the same set on both screens so navigation does not shift the atmosphere.

nodes.label: Home Columns Layout Container
nodes.rationale: Layout pattern: a horizontal flex wrapper with a 20px gap that in this export holds a single flexible 'Main Column' (Continue-working rail stacked above the today-plan card), i.e. the multi-column dashboard layout is reserved but collapsed to one column.

nodes.label: Tailwind CDN Runtime with Preflight Disabled
nodes.norm_label: tailwind cdn runtime with preflight disabled
nodes.rationale: Mechanism/decision: preflight is switched off (tailwind.config.corePlugins.preflight = false) and the export re-implements the reset it still needs itself (box-sizing on *, ::before, ::after; body margin 0), so the browser's CDN runtime cannot introduce base styles that would shift the pixel-exact design measurements.

nodes.label: Archived Actions (Restaurar / Eliminar)
nodes.rationale: Archived cards swap the open action for Restaurar plus a destructive trash control, giving archived items a recover-or-delete exit path.

nodes.label: Avatar Stack
nodes.rationale: Overlapping 18px initials avatars with white outlines (AL, MG) show collaborator presence inside a 30px slot without expanding the meta row.

nodes.label: Card Menu (Project Context Menu)
nodes.rationale: Floating 224px popover anchored to the card's ellipsis button; six actions are split into three groups by dividers (Abrir / Editar / Duplicar — Marcar como completado / Archivar — Eliminar) so destructive 'Eliminar' is isolated and tinted #B3261E.

nodes.label: Filter Tabs (Todos / Activos / Completados / Archivados)
nodes.rationale: Segmented control in a #F0F0F2 track; the selected tab is a raised white pill with a soft shadow, encoding selection by elevation instead of an underline.

nodes.label: Search Field (Buscar en modus…)
nodes.rationale: Pinned in the top header so global search is always reachable regardless of the section shown; placeholder names the product ('modus') instead of the scope.

nodes.label: Hover Actions (Abrir proyecto)
nodes.rationale: Primary action is revealed at the bottom of the card (states described as hover-revealed) to keep the resting card clean while giving a one-click path into the project.

nodes.label: Progress Row (Track / Fill / Percent)
nodes.rationale: 5px track with a #007AFF fill (w-[128px] fixed sample widths in the export) plus a numeric percentage label, giving both a glanceable and an exact completion signal.

nodes.label: Project Card
nodes.rationale: Uniform card anatomy (icon + name + ellipsis, description, progress row, meta row, status row) keeps every project comparable; state variants change only the trailing affordances (hover actions for active cards, restaurar/eliminar for archived, a Completado/Archivado chip in the header).

nodes.label: Project Search Field
nodes.rationale: Scoped search lives inside the content toolbar ('Buscar proyectos…') so it filters only the grid, deliberately separate from the header's global search.

nodes.label: 14 · Proyectos — Menú de proyecto (Project Menu Screen)
nodes.norm_label: 14 · proyectos — menu de proyecto (project menu screen)
nodes.rationale: Second artboard of the export: the identical Proyectos layout rendered together with the project card context menu, used to document the per-card action state rather than a different page.

nodes.label: 13 · Proyectos — Vista general (Projects Overview Screen)
nodes.rationale: Light-theme modus workspace artboard (1728x1080) presenting all projects as a two-column card grid so the user can scan progress, ownership and status at a glance; the header pairs the section badge with a global search, while the toolbar carries list-scoping controls.

nodes.label: Sidebar Navigation (App Nav Rail)
nodes.rationale: Icon-only 52px rail (Inicio, Proyectos, Tareas, Configuración + avatar) keeps the canvas width for content; the active destination is signalled by a filled #007AFF tile.

nodes.label: Sort Button (Ordenar por: Última actividad)
nodes.rationale: Shows the active sort value inline ('Última actividad') with an up/down arrow icon plus chevron, so the current ordering is legible without opening the control.

nodes.label: Project Status Chip (Completado / Archivado)
nodes.rationale: Replaces the ellipsis button in the card header for terminal states, making finished/archived cards visually distinct at grid level.

nodes.label: Project (Domain Entity)
nodes.rationale: Fields evidenced by the card: name, icon/colour, description, percent complete, task count ('14 / 40 tareas'), assignee avatars, in-progress task count, last-updated timestamp and status.

nodes.label: Project Lifecycle States (Activo / En progreso / Completado / Archivado)
nodes.norm_label: project lifecycle states (activo / en progreso / completado / archivado)
nodes.rationale: A four-state model reused across the UI: the filter tabs name the states, the card header chip displays the terminal ones, and the status row shows live progress ('3 en progreso', 'Completado hace 2 semanas', 'Archivado hace 1 mes').

nodes.label: modus (Application)
nodes.rationale: Product identity implied by the search placeholder 'Buscar en modus…' and the sparkles app logo; the design is an app shell (logo + nav rail + section header + content) rather than a standalone page.

nodes.label: Ambient Glow Backdrop
nodes.rationale: Four 640px radial-gradient ellipses (#4D9BFF, #B37DF0, #FFB86B, #5AC8FA at ~24% alpha) layered behind the content at z-index 0-3; they add depth and brand colour to a flat #F2F2F4 canvas without competing with the white surface cards stacked above (z-index 4+).

nodes.label: Design Token Palette (#007AFF accent on #F2F2F4 canvas)
nodes.norm_label: design token palette (#007aff accent on #f2f2f4 canvas)
nodes.rationale: Single accent #007AFF for interactive/selected elements, neutral ramp for surfaces (#F2F2F4 canvas, #EDEDF0 header, #E7E7EA rail, #FFFFFF cards), text ramp (#1D1D1F / #6E6E73 / #8E8E93), amber #FF9500 for in-progress dots and #B3261E reserved for destructive actions.

nodes.label: AI Assistant (Sparkles Glyph)
nodes.rationale: The lucide 'sparkles' glyph is the repeated visual signature of AI-generated content: app logo, chat header avatar, AI message avatars, the Propuesta de tareas header, and the 'Plan sugerido para hoy' / 'Generar nuevo' actions — a single mark lets users recognise machine-generated material anywhere in the workspace.

nodes.label: App Sidebar
nodes.rationale: Icon-only rail (52px, bg #E7E7EA): app logo, dividers, nav Inicio / Proyectos / Tareas / Configuración, spacer, user avatar with initials. The active destination (Nav Tareas) is the only item with a blue #007AFF fill, so current location is readable without labels; a hover tooltip ('Proyectos') supplies the missing text.

nodes.label: Card — Información general
nodes.rationale: Label/value stack for NOMBRE (Observatorio Regional), DESCRIPCIÓN, OBJETIVO and STACK (Next.js, PostgreSQL, TypeScript chips), with an 'Editar' ghost action in the card header — the plan's editable cover sheet.

nodes.label: Card — Plan sugerido para hoy
nodes.rationale: Each AI suggestion is a checkable row with an estimated duration chip (~30 min, ~45 min, ~40 min, ~1 h) and the card closes with '4 tareas · Tiempo estimado ≈ 2 h 55 min' — the design answers 'what realistically fits today', not merely 'what is next'. Regenerated via the sparkles 'Generar nuevo' ghost action.

nodes.label: Card — Progreso general
nodes.rationale: One large percentage plus a caption over a progress track, followed by a distribution list with mini bars for Por hacer / En progreso / Terminado / Backlog — the same four workflow states as the board columns, re-expressed as a health summary.

nodes.label: Card — Próximos hitos
nodes.rationale: Coarse-grained checkpoints above task level, each a name + done/total count (Módulo de investigadores completo 3/6, Testing general de la aplicación 1/8, Despliegue en producción 0/5) with a progress bar, plus a 'Hito' ghost add action.

nodes.label: Chat Composer
nodes.rationale: Attach button + text field + blue send button in one row, with the hint 'Enter para enviar · Shift+Enter para salto de línea' so multi-line prompts stay possible.

nodes.label: Chat Panel
nodes.rationale: Header is titled 'Chat con IA' and its subtitle defines the whole interaction model: 'Habla sobre tu proyecto, agrega tareas, pide planes o resuelve dudas.' — the chat is the conversational entry point for project work, not just a support widget. Left/right message bubbles distinguish user (blue, right, user avatar) from AI (grey, left, sparkles avatar).

nodes.label: Contexto Panel
nodes.rationale: Header description states the purpose: 'Información que la IA tendrá en cuenta.' — a curated, editable bundle (project context text, rules, resources) that steers AI output instead of forcing the user to repeat context in every prompt. Sections are separated by dividers and each has its own edit/add affordance.

nodes.label: Kanban Board
nodes.rationale: Titled 'Tablero Kanban' with subtitle 'Gestiona y visualiza el progreso de tus tareas.' The board area uses a subtle radial purple gradient background (#EFE9FA to #F2F2F4) to separate it from the flat white side panels; header holds 'Nueva tarea' (primary), 'Filtrar' and a more menu.

nodes.label: Kanban Column States
nodes.rationale: Four fixed workflow states — BACKLOG (6), POR HACER (4), EN PROGRESO (3), TERMINADO (4 visible + 'Ver más') — each with a colored status dot, uppercase tracking-wide title, count pill and an 'Agregar tarea' ghost row at the bottom of the column.

nodes.label: Observatorio Regional
nodes.rationale: Sample project used throughout the mock: 'El Observatorio Regional centraliza información de investigación científica de universidades de Centroamérica'. Its domain (investigadores, organizaciones, investigación) drives the demo task names.

nodes.label: Plan del proyecto
nodes.rationale: Project-level companion to the task-level board (right panel, 310px, subtitle shows the project name). It stacks a tab switcher and four cards — Información general, Progreso general, Próximos hitos, Plan sugerido para hoy — so scope, health and next actions are visible without leaving the board.

nodes.label: Plan Tabs
nodes.rationale: Segmented control inside a #F0F0F2 track with four sections — Resumen (active, white pill with shadow), Estructura, Cronograma, Notas — signalling that the plan has multiple views beyond the summary.

nodes.label: Propuesta de tareas
nodes.rationale: AI output is deliberately reviewable, not auto-applied: the card carries a count badge (6), a 'Pendiente' status chip, per-task checkboxes with grouped priority sections and nested subtasks, and ends in 'Descartar' vs 'Aplicar 6 tareas'. Nothing reaches the board without an explicit user action (human-in-the-loop). A compact single-task variant with 'Agregar' exists for follow-up proposals.

nodes.label: Recursos
nodes.rationale: Reference list attached as AI context; each row pairs a type icon (link / Figma / file-text) with resource name and source (Documentación API — docs.proyecto.com; Diseño principal — Figma; requerimientos.pdf), plus 'Ver todos (6)'.

nodes.label: Reglas a seguir
nodes.rationale: Compact list of standing instructions (e.g. 'Dividir funcionalidades grandes en subtareas.') shown as check-marked rows with a 'Ver todas (7)' link and an add-rule button — persistent constraints the AI should respect when generating tasks or plans.

nodes.label: Task Card
nodes.rationale: Uniform card anatomy: title row, tag chips, meta row with priority dot + label, subtask count with checklist icon, assignee avatar; 'En progreso' cards add a progress track and 'Terminado' cards replace it with a green done badge and a 'When' timestamp — the card reveals only the metadata relevant to its state.

nodes.label: Task Tag Taxonomy
nodes.rationale: Recurring tag vocabulary across cards: Backend, Rendimiento, Infraestructura, Datos, Testing, Documentación, UI/UX, Investigación, Investigadores, Bug — tinted chips per category, allowing filter-by-label in the board header.

nodes.label: 01 · Workspace — Chat · Kanban · Plan
nodes.rationale: Primary workspace screen (1728x1080): fixed left icon rail + top header, then a three-panel row — Chat (330px, left), Kanban board (center, flexible), Contexto (310px, right). Panels are separated by 1px dividers rather than cards, so the whole row reads as one continuous work surface.

nodes.label: 03 · Chat oculto — Kanban expandido
nodes.rationale: Second exported screen of the same workspace with the chat panel hidden: the board gains width and the right panel is the Plan del proyecto instead of Contexto. Demonstrates the collapse/expand states of the panel layout.

nodes.label: Panel Collapse Controls
nodes.rationale: Every side panel owns a chevron-left control — Collapse Chat, Ocultar Contexto, Collapse Plan — and the board header keeps a matching Reopen Chat button. The exported variant '03 · Chat oculto — Kanban expandido' shows the payoff: hiding a panel widens the board, so layout is user-adjustable rather than fixed.
